item.title: How to show or hide elements in React? A Step-by-Step Guide.
item.description: In modern web development, creating dynamic user interfaces is essential. The React library, a popular JavaScript tool, allows developers to build rich user interfaces by efficiently updating and rendering components based on data changes. One common requirement is to show or hide elements in React applications based on user interaction or application state. This article will guide you through different methods to show or hide elements in React using functional components, focusing on React 18+.

item.title: How to set focus on an input field after rendering in React
item.description: In modern React applications, managing focus on input elements is crucial for enhancing user experience. This practical guide will explore how to set focus on an input field after rendering in functional components using React 18+. We’ll delve into using the autoFocus attribute, the useRef hook, and the useEffect hook to achieve this.
